name: linear-workflow
description: Linear workflow for Claude Code: issue-next, issue-start, issue-review, issue-ship and issue-plan-cycle skills backed by a deterministic CLI, a linear-manager agent, and a mod that shows the current issue above the prompt with your other sessions and conflict warnings

linearApiKey.title: Linear API key
linearApiKey.description: Personal API key (Linear → Settings → Security & access). Left empty, the LINEAR_API_KEY environment variable is used, then LINEAR_API_KEY in <repo>/.env.

teamKeys.title: Team keys
teamKeys.description: Comma-separated Linear team keys to look for in branch names (e.g. ENG, OPS), used in repos whose .claude/linear.json sets no teamKey. Left empty: the keys of the teams you belong to.

registryFile.title: Sub-project registry
registryFile.description: Optional JSON file at the repo root listing sub-projects ({"projects":[{"key","path"}]}). When set, issue labels that match a key define the issue's scope, and edits outside it raise a drift toast. Empty: off.

pinCommand.title: Pin command
pinCommand.description: Slash command (without /) whose first argument is an issue id; running it pins that issue to the session. Defaults to the bundled /issue-start. Empty disables.

pollMinutes.title: Refresh interval (minutes)
pollMinutes.description: How often the issue is re-fetched from Linear.

showOtherSessions.title: Show other sessions
showOtherSessions.description: Share this session's issue with your other local Claude Code sessions (via ~/.claude/linear-workflow/sessions) and list theirs in the band.
